nodes.label: Fossils
nodes.subject: science
nodes.detail: Preserved traces of living organisms from the past. Form when organisms die in environments preventing complete decomposition (e.g., hot mud, sediment). Dating methods: relative dating (deeper fossils are older) and isotope ratio dating. Notable example: Rajasaurus dinosaur skull fossil found in the Narmada valley. Fossils provide direct evidence of extinct species and evolutionary history.
